source_caption_text:
Newly surfaced footage is reportedly showing Sean “Diddy” Combs inside Fort Dix prison with what is alleged to be a contraband phone. The footage has sparked renewed attention online, particularly because inmates are prohibited from possessing unauthorized personal devices.

According to reports circulating alongside the footage, Combs is also allegedly paying fellow inmates thousands of dollars each month for various personal services — including massages, preparing meals, doing laundry, and cleaning bathrooms before he uses them.

The claims have not been independently verified, and the circumstances surrounding the alleged footage and payments remain unclear. Still, the reports are generating significant discussion about prison life, inmate privileges, and how contraband makes its way into federal facilities.
